name: @stackra/zones
purpose: Zone / slot extensibility runtime — DI-owned zone registry, before/after/replace ordering, React + native bindings for <Zone> / <FormFieldZone> / <TableColumnZone>.
capabilities: DI-owned ZoneRegistry (BaseRegistry-backed) — one bucket per zoneId, idempotent-by-id
Pure resolveZoneOrder algorithm — before/after/replace/start/end + order tiebreak + when(ctx) filter
<Zone> compound React + native component for cross-module UI extension
useZone(zoneId) + useZoneContext hooks — permissions / features / params / tenant
SDUI Zone node component + registry — cross-module contributions on SDUI screens
Testing subpath — MockZoneRegistry + TestZonesProvider + canned contributions
ZoneMountRegistry bound to ZONE_MOUNT_REGISTRY — records live zone mounts from DOM sweeps
WebZonesModule composes ZonesModule.forRoot() + panel + inspector source + mount registry
when_to_use: Host pages need to be extended by other modules — UserGroup adding a table column, AgeRestriction inserting a form field, plug-in dropping a marketing banner into the hero.
when_not_to_use: For a fixed, non-extensible layout use plain React composition; for one-off feature flags use @stackra/authorization directly.
